title: PR self-review findings (one reviewer slice)
description: What a skill reviewer writes to its findings file: a JSON array, possibly empty. Severities match DevDigest's own CRITICAL / WARNING / SUGGESTION.

skill.description: Name of the skill whose rule is broken (the slice's skill).

rule.description: The rule's name or heading as written in the skill.

file.description: Repo-relative path, as in the diff heading.

line.description: New-file line number from the diff's left column.

evidence.description: Verbatim fragment of the code at (or within a few lines of) `line`.

message.description: What is wrong and why it matters, one or two sentences.
